1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Kawalan Produk Merokok Demi Kesihatan Awam (Tanda Amaran Larangan

Merokok) 2024.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Oktober 2024.

Tanggungjawab mempamerkan tanda amaran larangan merokok

2. (1) Tuan punya atau penghuni apa-apa kawasan atau tempat larangan

merokok yang diisytiharkan melalui Perintah Kawalan Produk Merokok Demi

Kesihatan Awam (Pengisytiharan Kawasan atau Tempat Larangan Merokok) 2024

[P. U. (A) 257/2024] hendaklah, pada setiap masa mempamerkan suatu tanda amaran

larangan merokok mengikut spesifikasi sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam

Jadual Pertama di mana-mana bahagian yang mudah dilihat pada bangunan

atau kenderaan atau di mana-mana laluan masuk kawasan atau tempat itu.

(2) Tanda amaran larangan merokok yang dipamerkan di bawah

subperaturan (1) hendaklah mengandungi kod QR yang jelas dan boleh diimbas

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Kedua.

JADUAL PERTAMA

[Subperaturan 2(1)]

TANDA AMARAN LARANGAN MEROKOK

1. Dalam Jadual ini—

"teksi" mempunyai erti yang diberikan kepadanya dalam Jadual Pertama

Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010 [Akta 715];

"kereta sewa" mempunyai erti yang diberikan kepadanya dalam Jadual Pertama

Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010; dan

"kenderaan e-hailing" mempunyai erti yang diberikan kepadanya dalam

Jadual Pertama Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010.

CONTROL OF SMOKING PRODUCTS FOR PUBLIC HEALTH ACT 2024

CONTROL OF SMOKING PRODUCTS FOR PUBLIC HEALTH

(WARNING SIGN OF PROHIBITION OF SMOKING) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 18(1)(a) and subsection 53(2)

of the Control of Smoking Products For Public Health Act 2024 [Act 852],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Control of Smoking Products

For Public Health (Warning Sign of Prohibition of Smoking) Regulations 2024.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 October 2024.

Duty to display a warning sign of prohibition of smoking

2. (1) The proprietor or occupier of any non-smoking area or place declared

by the Control of Smoking Products For Public Health (Declaration of Non-Smoking

Area or Place) Order 2024 [P.U. (A) 257/2024] shall, at all times display a warning sign

of prohibition of smoking in accordance with the specifications as specified in

the First Schedule at any conspicuous part of the building or vehicle or at any entrance to

the area or place.

(2) The warning sign of prohibition of smoking displayed under

subregulation (1) shall contain a clear and scannable QR code as specified

in the Second Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subregulation 2(1)]

WARNING SIGN OF PROHIBITION OF SMOKING

1. In this Schedule—

"taxi cab" has the meaning assigned to it in the First Schedule of the

Land Public Transport Act 2010 [Act 715];

"hire car" has the meaning assigned to it in the First Schedule of the

Land Public Transport Act 2010; and

"e-hailing vehicle" has the meaning assigned to it in the First Schedule of the

Land Public Transport Act 2010.
